Digital Land Survey in Hyderabad

Know your exact boundaries. A GPS-aided survey pins your plot's real corners, detects encroachment, and settles boundary doubts before you buy or build.

Key Takeaways

  • A digital land survey uses GPS-aided instruments to demarcate the exact boundaries of a plot or parcel.
  • It detects encroachment, boundary encroachment and mismatches between records and ground reality.
  • Essential before buying open land, before construction, and in boundary disputes.
  • The survey ties the ground position to the recorded survey number and extent.
  • Especially valuable for absentee and NRI owners who can't inspect the land themselves.

Land documents describe a parcel, but only a survey pins it to the ground. A digital, GPS-aided survey demarcates the real corners of your plot and shows whether the ground matches the records.

JaaGa arranges precise boundary surveys so you know exactly what you're buying, catch encroachment early, and settle boundary doubts with data.

When You Need a Survey

Before buying open land or a plot, to confirm the boundaries and extent match the documents.

Before construction, when fencing a plot, or whenever a neighbour's boundary is in question.

How the Survey Works

  1. 1

    Records Review

    We pull the survey number, extent and any village/FMB map for the parcel.

  2. 2

    Ground Survey

    A GPS-aided survey demarcates the plot's actual corners and boundaries on the ground.

  3. 3

    Compare to Records

    We compare the ground position and extent against the recorded details.

  4. 4

    Survey Report

    You receive a boundary report flagging any encroachment or mismatch.

Documents Required

  • Survey number and sub-division
  • Existing plot document / sale deed
  • Village / FMB map if available
  • Location and access details

Common Problems We Solve

Ground doesn't match paper

Extent on the ground often differs from the deed. The survey quantifies the gap.

Silent encroachment

Neighbours or roads may have crept in. GPS demarcation makes it visible.

Missing boundary stones

Old markers get lost. We re-establish corners from the records.

Why Digital Land Survey Matters

Buyers regularly discover, after purchase, that the plot on the ground is smaller than the paper or that a neighbour has encroached. A digital survey turns that expensive surprise into a fact you knew before paying.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a digital land survey?

A GPS-aided survey that demarcates the exact boundaries and extent of a plot on the ground and compares them to the land records.

Can it detect encroachment?

Yes — that's a primary use. It shows where the real boundary sits versus who has crept over it.

Do I need this to buy a plot?

It's strongly recommended for open land and plots, alongside document due diligence, so ground and paper agree.

Is this useful for NRIs?

Very — it's the on-ground check absentee owners can't do themselves.

Will you compare it to the records?

Yes. The report compares the surveyed boundaries to the recorded survey number and extent.
